class Counter
  attr_reader :value, :step, :original_step

  def initialize
    @value = 0
    @step = 1
    @original_step = nil
  end

  def bump
    self.value += self.step
    self
  end

  def with_step(new_step)
    saved_step = self.step
    self.step = new_step
    self.original_step = new_step

    yield
  ensure
    self.step = saved_step
  end

  def dup
    new_counter = Counter.new
    new_counter.value = self.value
    new_counter.step = self.step
    new_counter.original_step = self.original_step
    new_counter
  end

  def clone
    dup
  end
end

class Finder
  class << self
    def first_matching(source, &predicate)
      Enumerator.new do |yielder|
        consumed = 0
        counter = 0
        max_needed = nil
        yielder.method(:each) do |first_limit|
          max_needed ||= first_limit
          source.each do |elem|
            if predicate.call(elem)
              yielder.yield elem
              counter += 1
              if counter >= max_needed
                yielder.stop_iteration
                return
              end
            end
            consumed += 1 if predicate.call(elem) rescue false
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

class Truncator
  def self.truncate(str, limit)
    return str if str.force_encoding(Encoding::UTF_8).bytesize <= limit

    chars = str.chars
    return str[0..(limit - 4)] + '…' if chars.size >= limit && limit >= 4

    truncated = []

      if char_count >= limit - 1

        break
      end
      truncated << c
      char_count += 1
    end
    truncated.join
  end
end

class Counter
  def initialize
    @value = 0
    @step = 1
    @prev_step = nil # Not used on initialization
  end

  def value
    @value
  end

  def bump
    @value += @step
    self
  end

  def dup
    new_counter = Counter.new
    new_counter.send(:initialize_copy, self)
    new_counter.set_instance_variable(:@value, @value)
    new_counter.set_instance_variable(:@prev_step, nil)
    new_counter
  end

  def clone
    dup
  end

  def with_step(step)
    # Store the current step because we'll need it to revert back
    self.instance_variable_set(:@prev_step, @step)
    # Override this instance's current step
    @step = step
    yield
  ensure
    @step = self.instance_variable_get(:@prev_step) || 1
  end

  private

  def initialize_copy(source)
    # Override to deep copy step handling for clones/dups
    @step = source.instance_variable_get(:@step)
    unless source.instance_variable_defined?(:@prev_step)
      instance_variable_set(:@prev_step, @step)
    end
  end

class Weight
  include Comparable

  attr_reader :amount, :unit

  def initialize(amount, unit)
    @amount = amount
    @unit = unit
  end

  def eql?(other)
    other.is_a?(Weight) && other.amount == amount && other.unit == unit
  end

  def ==(other)
    eql?(other)
  end

  def <=>(other)
    raise ArgumentError, "cannot compare weights of different units" unless other.respond_to?(:unit) && unit == other.unit
    amount <=> other.amount
  end

  def self.sort(points)
    points.sort_with { |a, b| a <=> b }
  end

  def self.clamp(weight, min_weight, max_weight)
    raise ArgumentError, "cannot clamp to weights of different units" unless min_weight.unit == max_weight.unit &&
                                                                           min_weight.unit == weight.unit

    if weight <= min_weight
      min_weight
    elsif weight >= max_weight
      max_weight
    else
      weight
    end
  end

  def between?(weight1, weight2)
    raise ArgumentError, "cannot compare weights of different units" unless weight1.is_a?(Weight) &&
                                                                           weight1.unit == weight2.unit &&
                                                                           weight1.unit == unit

    weight = [weight1, weight2].min
    max_weight = [weight1, weight2].max
    weight <= self && self <= max_weight

class Proxy
  def initialize(target)
    @target = target
  end

  def method_missing(name, *args, &block)
    if @target.respond_to?(name)
      @target.send(name, *args, &block)
    else
      super
    end
  end

  def respond_to?(name, include_private = false)
    @target.respond_to?(name, include_private) || super
  end

  def methods
    @target.methods | super
  end

  def method(name)
    target_method = @target.method(name)
    if target_method
      self.method(name)
    else
      super
    end
    target_method
  rescue NoMethodError
    name = :method(name) if name.respond_to?(:to_s)
    raise NoMethodError, "no implicit conversion of #{name.to_s} into Method"
  end
ensure

class Delivery
  def initialize
    @tracking_statuses = {}
  end

  def log(tracking_id, status)
    @tracking_statuses[tracking_id] = status
  end

  def route(tracking_id)
    if block_given?
      yield(tracking_id, @tracking_statuses[tracking_id])
    else
      @tracking_statuses[tracking_id]
    end
  end
end

class AuditedDelivery < Delivery
  def audit_trail
    @audit_trail ||= []
  end

  def route(tracking_id)
    if block_given?
      status = @tracking_statuses[tracking_id]
      audit_trail << [tracking_id, status]
      yield(tracking_id, status)
    else
      status = @tracking_statuses[tracking_id]
      audit_trail << [tracking_id, status]
      status
    end
  end

  def log(tracking_id, status)
    super
    audit_trail << [tracking_id, status]
